The composition, lighting, and object positions look the same in every sampled frame.

Highlights, reflections, and the condensation pattern on the glass remain constant, so the excerpt is effectively a static shot of the glass.
The liquid surface and the floating object show no resolvable displacement, rotation, or deformation within the segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the glass or liquid is being poured, stirred, or moved before or after this cropped segment.
The precise identity of the yellow liquid and of the pale floating object.
uncertain_details: Any very slight internal shimmer or settling of the liquid/ice is not clearly resolvable at this sampling rate.
Camera motion is not evidenced: the background texture and the table/wall boundary stay fixed, so the view appears stationary rather than panning or zooming.
